text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"—'City might go for the Tiara route!' 
'Does that mean we might see her wearing 
the Triple Tiara!?'"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"‘I'm so totally hyped for this!!’ ...See, 
it's trending like crazy~."

(Tosen Jordan. Gold City's somewhat 
languid friend.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Like, everyone's making way too big a deal 
out of this. I haven't even decided if I'm 
doing the Triple Tiara route for my 
Classic year yet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still~, if she's going for the Hanshin JF, 
she must be pretty motivated, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ... Who knows.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? You totally could've told me, 
right!? We're besties for life, aren't 
we~☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I don't recall ever becoming your bestie.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No way!? Seriously, that's so mean~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, still, City wearing a tiara would 
seriously look insane. Bet she'd be 
gorgeous.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My bad, sorry. Still, City, you're 
overreacting. It's just facts that you're 
gorgeous, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I know everyone is praising me. I'm 
grateful for it, and I appreciate the 
recognition.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, that version of me isn't real. It's 
just an ornament someone else created.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It makes me wanna kick myself for only 
being able to make you say that, so I just 
don't wanna hear it right now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Who thinks City is overthinking 
everything way too much? Preeesent~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, why not just take a break from 
modeling for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That would just be running away, so I'm 
not doing it. There's no point unless I 
surpass the "model" version of myself 
through my running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Look, I've got commitments to the 
industry, and my schedule's packed years 
in advance anyway, so no can do.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, as expected of a star~! 
Whew-whee~♪"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, who cares about that? Show me more 
of your impressions!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eww, no way. I mean, we're not besties 4 
life, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, your face is scary! Jeez, alright, I 
get it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Btw, wanna hit the store for now? I'm 
starving.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Rooting for me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Um, City-san. Could you give that back to 
me pretty soon?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait just a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—That's surprising, though. It was pretty 
much all positive feedback.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd get dissed a lot more, with 
people saying I'm 'just a model' or that I 
lack real skill.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't tell me... Were you too scared 
to vanity search yourself?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Puha, for real? Like, when you're 
modeling, the haters don't phase you one 
bit, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Racing is different. Like I said before, 
I'm giving it everything I've got, for 
real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm? I don't really get it, but 
everyone's looking forward to seeing you 
run, City!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Looks that way. People really are 
expecting a lot from me, huh...
(Tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, an email from my manager...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, that manager? He's super scary, and 
I'm really not good with him~. He 
definitely hates me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Nah, I doubt that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, your Trainer's like that too, but 
like, the hot-blooded types? They really 
flock together, huh~."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You might have a point there... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara would suit you well. 
I'll adjust my work schedule, so please 
feel free to ask me anything"...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, for real? That manager person!? 
You mean she actually gave you the green 
light to run~!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So it really is like that, huh? To think 
my manager is actually rooting for me... 
feels unreal.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh wow, that's so awesome! Good for you, 
City!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Adjusting your schedule, you say. 
That's literally your job! Right?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you're not honest with yourself at 
all. You're totally smirkingâ

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Gotta give it my all. For real!
